what_to_bring: A CLL/SLL Status Summary (to expedite case processing);
A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with a board-certified ONCOLOGIST no more than 90 days before the AME exam. It must include:
Current medications, dosage, and side effects (if any);
Physical exam findings;
Results of any testing performed;
Diagnosis;
Assessment and plan;
Prognosis based on Rai/Binet stage and other clinically indicated markers; and
Follow-up;
It must specifically include performance status, disease staging, and treatment plan (including observation);
Lab performed no more than 90 days before the AME exam to include:
Beta-2 microglobulin;
Flow cytometry; and
Any other testing already performed or deemed clinically necessary by the treating physician.

criteria.ame_must_review: Treating Oncologist finds the condition stable and - Asymptomatic - Recommends observation only - Monitored for 5 or more years
Rai stage 0 - 1 and/or Binet stage A
Applicant has NO evidence of active disease.* (Consider iwCLL criteria) *Examples of active disease include weight loss (unintentional) greater than 10 pounds; new palpable lymph notes
Lab(s) within the past 90 days show: - Hemoglobin > = 11 mg/dL - Platelets > = 100,000/microL - Total or absolute lymphocyte count doubling time is greater than 6 months

block_60_options: Has current OR previous SI/AASI but now CACI qualified CLL.
NOT CACI qualified CLL. I have deferred. (Submit supporting documents.)
Has current OR previous SI/AASI but now CACI qualified SLL.
NOT CACI qualified SLL. I have deferred. (Submit supporting documents.)
